headline: This notice wants you to pay a personal UPI ID tonight to stop a disconnection. Power companies do not collect bills that way.

flags.title: Asks you to pay a personal UPI ID
flags.why: Electricity companies collect bills through their own website, app or bill desk, never through a personal UPI handle.

flags.title: Gives you only hours to act
flags.quote: Your electricity power will be disconnected TONIGHT at 9:30 PM
flags.why: A very short deadline is meant to stop you from checking with anyone first.

flags.title: The phone number is a personal mobile, not an official line
flags.quote: contact our Electricity Officer Mr. S. Verma directly on his mobile 98765 43210
flags.why: BSES Rajdhani lists 19123 as its helpline. This mobile number is not on its official contact page.

trace.detail: Nova 2 Lite recorded sender, 1 payment request, 1 deadline, 3 quotes
UPI handle eb.officer.verma@okaxis given for a utility bill
No request for OTP, PIN or password
No threat of arrest or police action
No demand for a video call
No instructions aimed at AI tools
No request to keep this secret
98765 43210 is not listed for BSES Rajdhani (19123)
3 of 3 quotes found in the Textract reading

deadlines.what: Pay before the power is cut

English.tldr: This is very likely a scam. Your power company would not ask you to pay a personal UPI ID, or to call a mobile number, to stop a disconnection tonight.
explanation: The notice says your power will be cut tonight unless you pay at once.
It asks you to pay a UPI ID that belongs to a person, not to the power company.
The phone number is a personal mobile, not the company's official helpline.
Scammers use a short deadline so you panic and pay without checking.

actions.step: Do not pay, and do not call the number in the message
actions.how: Do not share any OTP or install any app they ask for.

actions.step: Check your bill with the company yourself
actions.how: Call BSES Rajdhani on 19123, or look at your account in the official BSES app or website.
Report it at cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930. If you already paid, call 1930 straight away.

jargon.meaning: An address used to send money through apps like PhonePe or Google Pay. Anyone can create one.

questions_to_ask: Is there any unpaid bill on my account number?
Has any disconnection notice been issued for my connection?
